reference.title: Parameters
reference.shortdesc: The path parameters of the request URL path act as a placeholder for motor ID

section.p: The path parameters of the request URL path act as a placeholder for motor ID and dataset values:

row.entry: This motor has a unique identifier. The unique ID assigned to a motor can be found in the get all motors response.
conditions motor condition details (For more information, see the Conditions section)

section.p: For more information on API Datasets, refer to the Analytics User Guide.

The query parameters are added to the end of the request URL to provide additional information to the server. The start date and end date query parameters can be added to further filter down the datasets. For paginated results, the returned continuation token is added to subsequent requests.

row.entry: Specifies the starting timestamp in ISO-8601 date and time. The result will only contain items with a timestamp greater than or equal to this value. For example, 2020-07-10 15:00:00.000
Specifies the ending timestamp in ISO-8601 date and time. The result will only contain items with a timestamp less than or equal to this value. For example, 2020-07-10 15:30:00.000
Requests the next set of results. If more records are available, then a continuation token will be returned. For example, eyJwayI6ImFkaybSIsInNrIjoxNTkyMIyNDUyLCJ0ZW5hbnRJZCI6ImFkaSJ9

section.p: The header parameters are required because they instruct the API on handling requests such as authentication and compressing responses over 1KB.

row.entry: This parameter authenticates API requests. Provide a valid bearer token in the HTTP header. This bearer token can be obtained from the OAuth bearer token request.

Compresses responses. Responses over 1KB in size will automatically be compressed. The client must be capable of receiving and decompressing the response. Warning: The header is not set. Responses greater than 1 KB will fail.

gzip: Compression format using the Lempel-Ziv coding (LZ77), with a 32-bit CRC. deflate: Compression format using the zlib structure, with the deflate compression algorithm. br: Compression format using the Brotli algorithm.
